title: Existence of a complementary scalar q Chern component
statement: In the setting of [lem-sfb-rational-p1-scalar-q-homology-criterion], the scalar q Chern arrow admits a complementary shifted line component: there exists v from the shifted scalar line on Y to the derived pushforward of the shifted scalar line on the projective line such that biprod.desc v scalarQChern is an isomorphism.

source.place: Second identity, scalar trace base change before tensoring with q*K; complementary component of the normalized q splitting

proof.text: Apply the completed Chern splitting to r.tq and transport its complementary component through the q realization, finite scalar, rational scalar and closure comparisons. The canonical q pushforward comparison identifies the resulting second component with scalarQChern, and postcomposition with that isomorphism preserves invertibility.

proof_origin.place: Complementary component of the q Chern splitting

theorem scalar_q_chern_splitting_exists
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (r : Reference l Y δ family)
    (a : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      r.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (ha : CompletedChernNormalized l r.tq.toPresentation a) :
    ∃ v : ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y) 0).obj (line l c Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)) 0).obj
          (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧),
      IsIso (biprod.desc v (scalarQChern l c Y r a))
